finding: A direct exact integer sufficient criterion was derived: if a binary FD support has vertex-slice sizesa,b and a^3+b^3>64^3, rational within-slice weightsa^2/(a^3+b^3), b^2/(a^3+b^3) give positiveDelta. Bounded90-second truth-table MIPs at representatives1,2,3 of the three graph vertex orbits found only the64-word constant-vertex baseline (cube equality), all time-limited. This is NOT an infeasibility result.
negative_learning: Prior fixed-support ratio optimization/greedy weighted searches were already tried; their near-unit polynomial score is a degenerate boundary, not a strict witness. The new single-bias feasibility MIP has weak search progress and will not simply be rerun longer.
replacement: Use the full ten-coordinate product-weight polynomial with a GLOBAL384-bit strategy-table MIP, warm-started by the existing88-word code rather than the64-word boundary. For fixed positive integer t, maximize S=sum_w product_v t_v(w_v)^2 and compare S^3 to product_v(sum_a t_v(a)^3)^2. This changes both the objective and the feasible strategy representation from previous greedy/local-pool searches.
next_action: Implement one bounded global weighted strategy proposal with the established exact polynomial boundary. Any integer-positive producer candidate is frozen for parent finite-witness gates, not accepted or independently replayed automatically.
controls: All pinned archive/common-local-information/declaration bytes preserved; no bulk scientific replay or held-review consumer used.
